surrey-2354.uncertainty: Schematic prism only. Storeys are not measured metres. Official footprint may include lower attached portions; uniform extrusion does not reproduce setbacks or podium heights. No separate podium/townhouse count. Planning report is historical evidence, not a current certified survey. OSM lists 27 levels plus 2 roof levels; public planning report explicitly states 28 storeys. This discrepancy is retained; report count is selected for the demonstration, not silently reconciled.
